settings.heading: Engineered for elevation
settings.content: O's is manufactured by Invisible Elevations in Albuquerque, New Mexico, using all-natural flavors, a food-grade PG & VG base, and our priority-engineered molecular compound. Every device delivers roughly 600 clean, solventless puffs — no buttons, no charging, fully disposable.

settings.heading: Built for the shelf
settings.content: Distributed by Joon Distribution out of Austin, Texas, O's is formulated without nicotine, hemp, THC, cannabinoids, or spice — so it stays compliant under current Texas law and easy to stock with confidence. Three signature strains, one uncompromising standard.

settings.items:
Solventless|No solvents, ever — just a clean, engineered formula.
Invisible|Discreet vapor that disappears as fast as it forms.
Compliant|Formulated without any regulated or controlled substance.

settings.title: Elevated by ROSN
settings.lede: O's was built on a single idea: true elevation should be clean, compliant, and effortless.
